$comment: Reviewed RustSec acceptances. Enforced by scripts/check-cargo-audit.mjs.
Two-way: a finding of any kind (vulnerability, unmaintained, unsound,
yanked) that is not listed fails, and an entry whose finding is gone fails,
so an acceptance cannot outlive its risk. Keyed by advisory id; a yanked
crate has none and is keyed yanked:<crate>@<version>.
Every entry names the crate, the kind, and a reason that gives the
dependency path, why no fixed version can be reached from this repo, and
why the affected code does not matter in the shipped app. Try

RUSTSEC-2024-0370.reason: vmark > tauri > gtk 0.18 > glib 0.18 > glib-macros 0.18 > proc-macro-error. Linux only, and a proc-macro: it runs in the compiler and is not linked into the app. glib-macros 0.18 requires proc-macro-error 1.x and is the last GTK3 line; it leaves the tree only when Tauri moves its Linux backend off gtk 0.18.

RUSTSEC-2024-0429.reason: vmark > tauri > gtk 0.18 > glib 0.18.5, Linux only (absent from the macOS and Windows graphs). Fixed in glib 0.20, which the GTK3 bindings Tauri pins (gtk, gdk, webkit2gtk, soup3 at 0.18) cannot use, so no update is reachable. The unsound code is the Iterator impls of glib::VariantStrIter; nothing in this repo or in any other crate of the dependency graph names VariantStrIter.

RUSTSEC-2026-0370.reason: vmark > tauri-plugin-notification / tauri-plugin-opener / tauri-plugin-single-instance > zbus 5.16 > zvariant 5.12. Linux only (absent from the macOS and Windows graphs). The advisory names no affected version range and no patched release: the replacement is zbus 6.0.0, where this crate is the wire module, and every Tauri plugin here requires zbus 5.x, so no 6.x is reachable from this repo. zvariant is D-Bus serialization used only by Linux desktop integration and is not linked into the shipped macOS or Windows builds.

RUSTSEC-2026-0371.reason: vmark > tauri-plugin-notification / tauri-plugin-opener / tauri-plugin-single-instance > zbus 5.16 > zbus_names 4.3. No affected version range and no patched release; the replacement is the names module in zbus 6.0.0, which the Tauri plugins here do not accept yet (they require zbus 5.x). Linux only (absent from the macOS and Windows graphs). The crate supplies D-Bus name types used by Linux desktop integration; nothing in the shipped macOS or Windows builds links it.

RUSTSEC-2026-0372.reason: vmark > tauri-plugin-notification / tauri-plugin-opener / tauri-plugin-single-instance > zbus 5.16 > zvariant_derive 5.12. No affected version range and no patched release; the derive macros moved into zbus 6.0.0, which the Tauri plugins here do not accept (they require zbus 5.x). Linux only. It is a proc-macro: it runs in the compiler and is not linked into the shipped app, so the unmaintained status carries no runtime surface.
